utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—could you help spread the word and maybe collect a few donated tools or spare parts if folks have them?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can do that. I’ll ask around and see what tools or parts people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand if you need tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might need a wrench and maybe a screwdriver—I'll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah. Just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll set them aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it's coming together nicely, and folks are pitching in with tools and supplies. If you need, I can pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess. Could you let me know when the exact time and drop-off spot are set? I like to plan ahead so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as they set the exact time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam. Could you help by checking the donation drop-off at the community center and letting me know what’s there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll stop by the community center and check the drop-off, then let you know what’s there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I heard about the repair drive — I’m telling folks to swing by and lend a hand if they can. Want me to pass along the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Yes, please pass them along — I might be able to help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know you’re open to helping. If you want, I can also share the time and place once I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m putting together the repair drive now. If you know anyone who needs help or wants to volunteer, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted as the details come together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, sorry I’m late—what repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — I meant the neighborhood repair drive for the broken fence and porch lights. I just wanted to make sure you were the one who could help before I gave details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I’ll need the details on the repair drive first. When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s this Saturday morning, starting at 9 by the community center. I’ll send you the full list of repairs and supplies right after this.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—send the list when you can, and I’ll see what I can line up around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting some good attention—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s been picking up nicely—people are dropping off tools, parts, and a few old appliances to fix up. We’re still gathering a bit more, but it’s looking really promising.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—sounds like it’s really coming together. Let me know if you hear of anything else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m in—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you confirm which items are still on the list? I want to make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not seeing the list in front of me—can you send the items over? I’ll skim it and confirm right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what do they need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly tools and a few extra hands, I think. I should check the list again so I don't mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—if you check the list, I can help sort through it with you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik—that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make a list of anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Cleo—I’ll mention it at the repair drive and keep everyone in the loop. If you spot anything missing, just tell me and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a few more donations today. I’m heading out on errands anyway, so I can check in and see what still needs to be covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Ira. If you find out what’s still needed, let me know and I can try to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll swing by and ask what’s left on the list. I’ll let you know as soon as I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren. We’re gathering any broken small appliances and tools this weekend, then I’ll sort them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds good—I'll bring by anything broken I can find. Just remind me where and when to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what needs fixing, and when do you want to start?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure yet — I just know the repair drive is coming up. I’ll check what needs fixing and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with the repair drive—got a few tools I can bring by. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help—if you’ve got a list of what needs fixing, I can bring the right tools by later today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great—thank you! We still need folks to sort donations, hand out flyers, and help coordinate drop-offs; I can send out a quick invite to everyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can sort donations and help with flyers. If you send the invite, I’ll take a shift and help with drop-offs too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That repair drive sounds like a great idea—how can I help?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules. Could you help keep track of the drop-off spot and any addresses we collect?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can keep a running list of the drop-off spot and every address we collect.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I'll help keep the repair drive organized and moving. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—can you start by listing what tools and spare parts we already have, so I can see what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure — I’ll put together a quick inventory of the tools and spare parts we already have and send it over. Then we can spot what’s missing right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive a little late—how’s it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s going pretty well, actually. Have you got anything you want to donate or help fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I might have a couple of old tools I could bring by, and I can help sort things for a bit if that’d be useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit tied up, but I can help if you need something specific.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo. If you could just drop off any extra tools or supplies by the school office, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing—I can drop off a few extra tools and supplies at the school office later today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, can you confirm what’s already been fixed and what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I don’t have the full list yet, but I can help sort it out—just tell me what’s been completed and what’s left.
